jd:
Clinical Data Analyst - Meadowlark Health Systems

About the role
Meadowlark builds analytics for hospital networks. You will translate clinical needs into reports and data requirements. The team works in two-week sprints, holds weekly demos and keeps documentation next to the code. Engineers pair often, give honest feedback and set aside time every sprint to improve tooling, and new colleagues are paired with a buddy for their first month.

Responsibilities
- Gather requirements from clinicians
- Build and validate reports
- Support data quality improvement

Requirements
- Knowledge of electronic health records (EHR) systems
- Understanding of HIPAA
- SQL for reporting
- Requirements gathering with clinical teams
- HL7 or FHIR data standards
- Excel reporting

Nice to have
- Python
- Tableau

Benefits
- Flexible working hours and a yearly learning budget
- 25 days of paid leave plus public holidays
- We review every application and reply within two weeks
